embeds.title: v0.9.0 — a choice every dawn (2/2)
embeds.description:
**THE SHOP**
• **Ward-Weaver** retires from the stalls — the only rat that rode two straight seasons at 5-in-6 boards, unmoved by this season's own anti-stacking rule. Still rides if you've already got one; the stalls just stop selling him. A real fix is scoped for a later season.
• **Gutter-Acolyte** retires too — it never did the job it was built for. Board measurements found poison is only 1-4% of real damage once a line carries relics, so an attack-sapper has to earn its slot back on its own merits.

**PVP LEAGUE**
• Poison decay is reverted — it dulled every poison source to fix one matchup and barely moved that matchup anyway. Poison holds at full strength again until the wave clears, like before last patch.
• **Draughtsman Moe** reworked instead: she no longer rots your whole line at once. Now she keeps gnawing on whichever rat stands in front of her, refreshing — not stacking — as long as she's alive. One rat rotting at a time, not your whole board.
• **MBP Rat** — attack corrected: 4 ⇒ **3**, matching the Slink-Rat kit it carries over from. A copy slip from last patch, not a nerf.

not everything that rode in with this season is written here.
